name: ICC Cricket world cup highlights 2011
overview:
RELIVE THE ICC CRICKET WORLD CUP 2011, arguably the greatest cricket tournament on the planet, from the stunning Opening Ceremony to it's exciting climax in Mumbai.

Follow the unforgettable moments of the tournament, the big scores from the little master Tendulkar, the fastest hundred in World Cup history, the match winning partnerships and all the crucial wickets.

We take you through the action from the

unpredictable groups stages, including arguably the most exciting tie in ICC World Cup history, the memorable major upsets and some sensational individual performances.

We also have extensive coverage from all the

nailbiting matches in the knockout stages involving the biggest names in the sport as they looked to

pursue their ambitions of World Cup success.

And of course we capture all the emotion of the truly

memorable final, the climax of what was the unforgettable ICC Cricket World Cup 2011.
